question: In the study of oil reservoir conversion to underground gas storage, what saturation pressure and gas-oil ratio does the crude oil have, and what is its density under formation conditions?
rendered: According to the text on page 7 of "Phase Behavior and Mass Transfer During Oil Reservoir Conversion to Underground Gas Storage: Effects on Storage Capacity and Recovery Efficiency", the saturation pressure of the crude oil is 26.08 MPa, the gas-oil ratio is 152.8 m3/m3, and the crude oil density under formation conditions is 0.6877 g/cm3.
